name: Adni
long_description:
Adni helps companies reach the right healthcare workers faster and cheaper. We combine a verified database of 2.4M licensed clinicians with an AI sourcing agent and AI-powered marketing services. Our career app, where 200,000+ nurses and allied health workers find jobs, talk to career coaches, and track credentials, keeps that network engaged and growing.

Our customers include Massachusetts General Hospital, Penn Medicine, ChristianaCare, Stepful, Medical Solutions, Medline, Jaanuu, and Proliability.

Founded by two nurses. Backed by YC, Flare Capital, Liquid 2, Fresco, Augment, Crista Galli, Adam Grant, and the founders of CareRev, Clipboard Health, and Papa.
one_liner: The career network for healthcare workers
